data.gender_notes: Ainaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘a’na, which means ‘to help’ or ‘to support’. In Islamic history, the name Ainaaz is associated with several noble figures who provided assistance and support to their communities and leaders. The name Ainaaz carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ainaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be of service to others, to provide support and assistance.
data.etymology: Ainaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ainaaz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عيناز
in_arabic.long_meaning: مشتق من العين التي تعني النور والرؤية، والاز التي تشير إلى الجمال والكمال، يحمل اسم عيناز معنى النور والجمال والعطاء، ويُعتبر اسمًا مفضلًا في الثقافة الإسلامية لارتباطه بالضوء والرشاد

in_urdu.name: عیناز
in_urdu.long_meaning: عیناز کا نام عربی gốc سے ماخوذ ہے، جہاں عین کا معنی نور اور رؤیت ہے، اور از کا معنی جمال اور کمال ہے، یہ نام برصغیر مسلم ثقافت میں بہت پسند کیا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نور اور جمال کی علامت ہے
